title: 6 in 6
texts:
This session works well on a training board or using steep bouldering walls. 

Choose problems that are 4-6 moves long and around your flash grade but ones that are well rehearsed. They should be difficult to climb and require a high amount of effort but manageable for you. You can either use the same problem for every rep to complete a full set, or complete a different problem every rep to complete your set. 

Climb each problem on the minute then rest for the remainder of the minute before completing your next rep (this should equate to approximately 25 seconds climbing, 35 seconds resting). Repeat 6 times to complete a full set.
